title: Gauss Sum Squared Formula: Corrected Proof via Mathlib
description: Corrects and proves the Gauss sum squared formula from the parent entry (OQ-02). The parent axiomatized ∃ τ : ℤ, τ² = (-1)^{(p-1)/2} · p — a false claim since primes are not perfect squares. The correct formula: gaussSum χ ψ ^ 2 = χ(-1) · p, where τ = gaussSum χ ψ lives in the codomain R' of the characters (not in ℤ). Proved directly from Mathlib's `gaussSum_sq` theorem.

meta.author: Lean Genius
meta.assumptions: No axioms. All results proved from Mathlib foundations.
originalContributions: gauss_sum_sq_corrected: gaussSum χ ψ ^ 2 = χ(-1) * p for quadratic characters — proved from Mathlib's gaussSum_sq [line 68]

gauss_sum_analysis: Summary conjunction of the proved formula and the falsity of the integer axiom [line 145]
openQuestions: Provide a concrete construction: exhibit a primitive additive character ψ : AddChar (ZMod p) ℂ using complex exponentials, and prove the resulting Gauss sum equals √{(-1)^{(p-1)/2} · p} exactly
Formalize the full Gauss sum proof of quadratic reciprocity: from τ² = χ(-1)·p, derive QR via Frobenius lifting in Mathlib's cyclotomic infrastructure
meta.mathContext: The Gauss sum G(χ, ψ) = Σ_{a ∈ ZMod p} χ(a) · ψ(a) for a nontrivial quadratic character χ and primitive additive character ψ satisfies G² = χ(-1) · p. This corrects a false axiom in the parent entry (OQ-02) which incorrectly claimed the sum lay in ℤ. The formula is a key step in the Gauss sum proof of quadratic reciprocity (third QR pathway after Eisenstein's and Zolotarev's).
meta.proofStrategy: gauss_sum_sq_corrected applies Mathlib.NumberTheory.GaussSum.gaussSum_sq and rewrites Fintype.card (ZMod p) to p via ZMod.card. parent_axiom_is_false uses Nat.Prime to show primes are not perfect squares (case τ² = p) and sq_nonneg to rule out τ² = -p.
meta.historicalContext: Gauss (Disquisitiones Arithmeticae, 1801, §356) introduced the Gauss sum G = Σ χ(a) ζ^a ∈ ℤ[ζ_p] and proved G² = (-1)^{(p-1)/2} · p. This is the key identity enabling the fourth proof of quadratic reciprocity. The confusion over whether G lives in ℤ (no) vs ℤ[ζ_p] or ℂ (yes) was corrected here.
meta.problemStatement: The parent entry OQ-02 axiomatized gauss_sum_sq claiming ∃ τ : ℤ, τ² = (-1)^{(p/2)} · p. Is this correct? If not, what is the correct statement and can it be proved?

sections.title: Corrected Gauss Sum Formula
sections.summary: The main theorem: gaussSum χ ψ ^ 2 = χ(-1) * p for any nontrivial quadratic character over ZMod p and primitive additive character, with values in a domain R'. Proved via Mathlib's gaussSum_sq.

sections.title: Legendre Symbol Connection
sections.summary: The Legendre symbol is the quadratic character of ZMod p by definition. The Gauss sum of the Legendre character embedded via φ : ℤ →+* R' satisfies the corrected formula.

sections.title: Parent Axiom Is False
sections.summary: The parent entry's axiom gauss_sum_sq (claiming τ : ℤ) is proved false for all odd primes p. Case p ≡ 1 (mod 4): need τ² = p but p is not a perfect square. Case p ≡ 3 (mod 4): need τ² = -p < 0 but τ² ≥ 0.

sections.title: Complete Analysis
sections.summary: Summary theorem combining both results: the correct formula is proved, and the parent's incorrect axiom is disproved.
